def predict(lib, y, i, j, shrink):
    from scipy.linalg import cho_factor
    from scipy.linalg import cho_solve
    from scipy.optimize import minimize
    k0 = np.array(list(lib.values()))
    k0 = k0 - k0.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True) - k0.mean(axis=2, keepdims=True) + k0.mean(axis=(1, 2), keepdims=True)
    k0 /= np.maximum(np.diagonal(k0, axis1=1, axis2=2).mean(1), 1e-06)[:, None, None]
    k0 = np.concatenate((k0, np.ones_like(k0[:1]), np.eye(k0.shape[1])[None]), axis=0)
    k = k0[:, i[:, None], i]
    c = k0[:, j[:, None], i]
    m = len(k)
    yy = y[i]
    prior = np.r_[np.full(m - 3, 0.15 / (m - 3)), 0.09, 0.12, 0.0006]
    k = k.reshape(m, -1)

    def objective(w):
        a = np.exp(w)
        cs = cho_factor((a @ k).reshape(len(i), len(i)))
        v = cho_solve(cs, yy)
        inv = cho_solve(cs, np.eye(len(i)))
        p = w - np.log(prior)
        return (0.5 * yy @ v + np.log(cs[0].diagonal()).sum() + 0.5 * shrink * (p @ p), 0.5 * a * (k @ (inv - np.outer(v, v)).ravel()) + shrink * p)
    r = minimize(objective, np.log(prior), jac=True, bounds=[(-16, 2)] * m, method='L-BFGS-B', options={'maxiter': 150})
    a = np.exp(r.x)
    v = cho_solve(cho_factor((a @ k).reshape(len(i), len(i))), yy)
    return (a @ (c @ v), a)
